item.title: espflash – a new Go tool to serially flash firmware to Espressif devices
item.description: espflash espflash is a Go command-line tool and library for flashing firmware to Espressif ESP8266 and ESP32-family microcontrollers over a serial (UART) connection. Authored by TinyGo under a BSD-3-Clause license. Supported Chips ESP8266 ESP32 ESP32-S2 ESP32-S3 ESP32-C2 (ESP8684) ESP32-C3 ESP32-C6 ESP32-H2 Features Auto-detection: Automatically identifies the connected ESP chip Compressed transfers: Uses zlib compression for […]
